name: Merfolk Trickster — fired "It loses all abilities" takes only a creature an opponent controls
notes: Memory: project_pronoun_target_antecedent_restriction_2026-10-14. 'Tap target creature an opponent controls. It loses all abilities until end of turn.' When fired, 'It' is rewritten as the target it stands for (_abilityTargetBefore), but _TARGET_PHRASE_RE kept only a closing 'you control / own', so it became plain 'target creature' and the picker listed your creatures and the Trickster itself. 'an opponent controls', 'you don't control' and 'your opponents control' are now part of the phrase.
